nodes.label: Event Loop
nodes.rationale: Call stack empty then flush microtasks completely, then one macrotask per tick, then rAF/render

nodes.label: Microtask Queue
nodes.rationale: Promises, queueMicrotask, process.nextTick — flushed completely before macrotasks

nodes.label: Macrotask Queue
nodes.rationale: setTimeout, setInterval, setImmediate, I/O — one task per tick

nodes.label: Ignition Interpreter

nodes.label: TurboFan Optimizing Compiler

nodes.label: V8 Deoptimization

nodes.norm_label: execution context closures and scope guide

nodes.label: Execution Context
nodes.rationale: Creation phase (memory, TDZ, this) then execution phase; managed by call stack

nodes.label: Closure
nodes.rationale: Inner function retains [[Environment]] to outer lexical scope; can prevent GC of outer vars

nodes.label: Proxy
nodes.rationale: Wraps target with traps for get/set/has/deleteProperty; identity !== target

nodes.label: Reflect
nodes.rationale: Standardized functional implementations of fundamental object operations

nodes.label: structuredClone
nodes.rationale: Native deep clone supporting Date, Map, Set, ArrayBuffer, circular refs unlike JSON hack

nodes.label: Proxy-Based Reactive State Store
nodes.rationale: Similar to Vue 3 reactivity or MobX via property traps and onChange

nodes.label: layout.tsx

nodes.label: template.tsx

nodes.label: loading.tsx

nodes.label: error.tsx

nodes.label: Route Groups (name)

nodes.label: Parallel Routes @slot
nodes.rationale: Independent loading/error/navigation per named slot in one layout

nodes.label: Intercepting Routes (.) / (..)

nodes.label: useContext
nodes.rationale: Establishes Fiber Context dependency subscriptions; Provider value changes via Object.is trigger propagateContextChange, marking consumers NeedsUpdate even through React.memo.

nodes.label: Visual Tearing
nodes.rationale: In Concurrent Mode, interruptible renders can let components read different external store values mid-transition.

nodes.label: Memoized Context Provider Value
nodes.rationale: Inline Provider value objects force all consumers to re-render every Provider render; useMemo stabilizes the value.

nodes.label: Immutable getSnapshot Contract
nodes.rationale: getSnapshot must return stable/immutable references; new objects every call cause infinite re-render loops.

nodes.label: useRef
nodes.rationale: Persistent mutable {current} container on Fiber memoizedState; mutations do not re-render; identity stable across renders.

nodes.label: useImperativeHandle
nodes.rationale: Customizes ref handle exposed to parents for limited imperative methods while encapsulating internal DOM.

nodes.label: forwardRef Deprecated (React 19)
nodes.rationale: React 19 allows ref as a standard function-component prop, deprecating forwardRef.

nodes.label: No ref.current During Render
nodes.rationale: Reading/writing ref.current in render breaks Concurrent Mode and StrictMode; mutate only in effects/handlers.

nodes.label: Refs as Escape Hatches
nodes.rationale: Prefer declarative React state over imperative DOM manipulation for UI that React should own.

nodes.label: Flight Protocol
nodes.rationale: Stream of serialized React element instructions (not raw HTML/JSON) enabling progressive RSC into client trees.

nodes.label: Serializable Server/Client Props
nodes.rationale: Cannot pass functions/class instances/Symbols from Server to Client Components; use Server Actions or serializable data.

nodes.label: Zero-Bundle Server Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Heavy parsers/DB clients stay on server under RSC, improving LCP vs shipping them to the browser.

nodes.label: Streaming SSR
nodes.rationale: Shell phase then Suspense streaming of template chunks over open HTTP connection.

nodes.label: Prefer Streaming Over Sync SSR
nodes.rationale: renderToString/staticMarkup block entire tree; pipeable/readable streams are default for interactive SSR since React 18.

nodes.label: useId
nodes.rationale: Hydration-safe IDs derived from Fiber tree position (:r0:, :r1:), matching server and client.

nodes.label: Never useId for List Keys
nodes.rationale: useId for key props destroys DOM state on list reorders; use stable database IDs.

nodes.label: Extend Not Replace Default Middleware
nodes.rationale: Passing a bare array drops thunk and invariant checks; always getDefaultMiddleware().concat().

nodes.label: Per-Request Store for SSR
nodes.rationale: Module-scope store on Node leaks state across concurrent SSR requests; use makeStore() per request.

nodes.label: Immer Mutate-or-Return Rule
nodes.rationale: Either mutate draft or return new value — never both in same reducer branch.

nodes.label: createAction
nodes.rationale: Standalone action creators for cross-cutting events outside any slice reducer map.

nodes.label: Prefer .match() Over Type Strings
nodes.rationale: String type comparisons break on rename and lack payload narrowing; use creator.match().

nodes.label: Key Async Status by Arg
nodes.rationale: Single global loading flag races concurrent args; key status by action.meta.arg.

nodes.label: Prefer rejectWithValue for Typed Errors
nodes.rationale: throw only sets action.error string; rejectWithValue puts structured error on action.payload.

nodes.label: createApi (RTK Query)
nodes.rationale: Generates reducer, middleware, and React hooks from declarative endpoints; replaces hand-written async thunk loading boilerplate.

nodes.label: One createApi Per Service
nodes.rationale: Multiple createApi instances fragment cache and duplicate middleware; extend via injectEndpoints.

nodes.label: createSelector
nodes.rationale: Reselect memoization: recompute result function only when input selector outputs change by reference equality.

nodes.label: Stable Input Selector References
nodes.rationale: Input selectors that allocate new arrays every call defeat memoization; filter in the result function.

nodes.label: Per-Component Selector Instances
nodes.rationale: Shared parameterized selectors thrash cache size 1; makeSelectX + useMemo per component.

nodes.label: upsertOne vs addOne
nodes.rationale: addOne is no-op on existing ids; use upsertOne when entity may already exist.

nodes.label: createListenerMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Async/await side-effect orchestration alternative to sagas; cancellable effects with condition/delay/take.

nodes.label: Prepend listenerMiddleware
nodes.rationale: RTK recommends .prepend() so effects run early before invariant freezes.

nodes.label: Debounce via cancelActiveListeners
nodes.rationale: Without cancel, each keystroke schedules independent delayed saves; cancel implements takeLatest-style debounce.

nodes.label: useSelector
nodes.rationale: Direct store.subscribe re-renders only when selector result fails reference equality — not Context cascade.

nodes.label: Object Literal Selector Pitfall
nodes.rationale: Inline object returns re-render on every dispatch under ===; use shallowEqual or separate primitive selectors.

nodes.label: Immer produce()
nodes.rationale: Proxy drafts record mutations and produce structurally shared immutable next state.

nodes.label: Mutate Draft OR Return New Value
nodes.rationale: Mixing mutation and return throws; full reset must return initialState explicitly.
nodes.norm_label: mutate draft or return new value

nodes.label: No Mutation Outside Reducers
nodes.rationale: Async callbacks see real state not drafts; all changes must dispatch through Immer-wrapped reducers.

nodes.label: RootState
nodes.rationale: ReturnType<typeof store.getState> — inferred from actual reducer map, not hand-written.

nodes.label: AppDispatch
nodes.rationale: typeof store.dispatch includes thunk middleware so dispatching functions type-checks.

nodes.label: Derive RootState From Store
nodes.rationale: Hand-written RootState drifts; always derive from store.getState.

nodes.label: Time-Travel Debugging
nodes.rationale: Replay pure reducers over action log to jump to historical state snapshots.

nodes.label: Gate DevTools Off in Production
nodes.rationale: Misconfigured NODE_ENV can expose tokens/PII; explicitly gate and sanitize sensitive fields.

nodes.label: Pure Reducers for Time-Travel
nodes.rationale: Date.now()/Math.random() inside reducers break replay fidelity; put nondeterminism in action payloads.

nodes.label: combineSlices
nodes.rationale: RTK 2.x combined reducer with .inject(slice) for dynamic reducer injection via replaceReducer.

nodes.label: Guard Uninjected Slice State
nodes.rationale: state.billing is undefined until injection; use optional chaining or only read inside lazy features.

nodes.label: Test Reducers Directly
nodes.rationale: Slice reducers are pure (state, action) => newState; no store/DOM needed.

nodes.label: Fresh Store Per Test
nodes.rationale: Shared store instances leak state and cause order-dependent flakiness.

nodes.label: Prefer MSW Over Global fetch Mocks
nodes.rationale: MSW runs real fetchBaseQuery paths; hand mocks drift from API contracts.
nodes.norm_label: prefer msw over global fetch mocks

nodes.label: Classic Redux to RTK Migration
nodes.rationale: Incremental: same primitives under RTK ergonomics layers; no big-bang rewrite required.

nodes.label: Preserve Action Type Strings During Migration
nodes.rationale: Renaming types while converting reducers breaks sagas/analytics/replay logs; rename later separately.
nodes.norm_label: preserve action type strings during migration

nodes.label: Migrate Store Then Slices Then Middleware
nodes.rationale: Store-only step first, then one slice at a time, then saga replacement — each verified by tests.
nodes.norm_label: migrate store then slices then middleware

nodes.rationale: All type annotations are erased at runtime; no runtime type representation

nodes.label: Type Inference and Widening
nodes.rationale: let widens to general type; const preserves literal types

nodes.label: type vs interface
nodes.rationale: interface supports declaration merging; type expresses unions/intersections/mapped/conditional

nodes.label: Structural Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Compatible if shape matches; no nominal identity required

nodes.label: Excess Property Checks
nodes.rationale: Stricter checks only for fresh object literals; variables bypass typo detection

nodes.label: Structural identity without semantic equivalence
nodes.rationale: Celsius and Fahrenheit both {value:number} are interchangeable without branded types

nodes.label: readonly properties
nodes.rationale: Compile-time only; does not deep-freeze at runtime

nodes.label: Distributive Conditional Types

nodes.label: Lexical Scope Chain
nodes.rationale: Identifier resolution is lexical (where written), not dynamic call-site scoping.

nodes.label: Closures
nodes.rationale: Inner function retains outer [[Environment]]; retains entire enclosing scope, not just referenced vars.

nodes.label: Closure Retaining Large Objects
nodes.rationale: Extract only needed fields before closing over large objects so GC can reclaim the rest.

nodes.label: this Binding Rules
nodes.rationale: Precedence: new > explicit (call/apply/bind) > implicit (obj.method) > default (undefined strict / global sloppy).

nodes.label: Arrow Function Lexical this
nodes.rationale: Arrows have no own this; inherit lexically from enclosing scope, ignore all four binding rules.

nodes.label: Detached Method this Loss
nodes.rationale: Passing obj.method as callback loses object context; fix with bind or arrow.

nodes.label: Arrow Function
nodes.rationale: Not callable before init; no own this/arguments/prototype; cannot be used with new.

nodes.label: Default Parameters
nodes.rationale: Defaults trigger only for undefined/omitted — not null, 0, '', false.

nodes.label: IIFE
nodes.rationale: Legacy scope isolation; largely replaced by let/const and ES modules.

nodes.label: Currying
nodes.rationale: Multi-arg function to chain of single-arg functions enabling partial application.

nodes.label: Prototype Chain
nodes.rationale: Property lookup walks instance then [[Prototype]] links; class is sugar over same model.

nodes.label: class Syntax
nodes.rationale: Methods on .prototype; non-enumerable; not hoisted like functions (TDZ); extends/super for inheritance.

nodes.label: Private Fields (#field)
nodes.rationale: Engine-enforced encapsulation; inaccessible via bracket notation or Reflect.

nodes.label: super() in Subclass Constructor
nodes.rationale: Must call super() before using this in derived constructors.

nodes.label: Promise
nodes.rationale: State machine: pending → fulfilled or rejected; one-way permanent transition.

nodes.label: async/await
nodes.rationale: Syntactic sugar over Promises; async always returns Promise; await pauses only the async function.

nodes.label: Promise.all
nodes.rationale: Fail-fast: rejects on first rejection.

nodes.label: Promise.allSettled
nodes.rationale: Waits for all; never rejects; partial success semantics.

nodes.label: JavaScript Event Loop
nodes.rationale: Coordinates call stack, microtasks, paint, macrotasks for concurrent-feeling I/O on single thread.

nodes.label: requestAnimationFrame
nodes.rationale: Runs after microtasks, before paint; for visually synchronized updates.

nodes.label: process.nextTick (Node)
nodes.rationale: Higher priority than Promise microtasks; drained after every phase transition; can starve I/O.

nodes.label: Node Event Loop Phases
nodes.rationale: timers → pending → poll → check (setImmediate) → close.

nodes.label: Microtask Starvation of Rendering
nodes.rationale: Recursive queueMicrotask/Promise chains can freeze UI by never yielding to macrotasks/paint.

nodes.label: Iterable Protocol
nodes.rationale: Object is iterable if [Symbol.iterator]() returns iterator with next() → {value, done}.

nodes.label: Generator Function (function*)
nodes.rationale: Pausable via yield; body does not run until .next(); returned generator is single-use iterator.

nodes.label: Async Generator (async function*)
nodes.rationale: Combines yield with await; consume with for await...of.

nodes.label: Garbage Collection (Mark-and-Sweep)
nodes.rationale: Mark reachable from roots then sweep unmarked; only unreachable objects reclaimed.

nodes.label: Common Memory Leak Patterns
nodes.rationale: Forgotten timers/listeners, detached DOM refs, unbounded closures over large scopes.

nodes.label: WeakMap
nodes.rationale: Weak keys do not prevent GC; ideal for object-keyed metadata/caches.

nodes.label: WeakRef
nodes.rationale: Opt-in weak reference; GC timing non-deterministic — not for correctness-critical cleanup.

nodes.label: Detached DOM Node Leak
nodes.rationale: JS refs and unremoved listeners keep removed DOM subtrees alive.

nodes.label: ES Modules (import/export)
nodes.rationale: Static, live bindings, async load; enables tree-shaking.

nodes.label: CommonJS (require/module.exports)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic require, value copy at require time, synchronous load.

nodes.label: Dynamic import()
nodes.rationale: Promise-returning; conditional/lazy load; basis of code-splitting.

nodes.label: Circular Module Dependencies
nodes.rationale: ESM live bindings often OK; CJS can return partially populated exports.

nodes.label: Spread Operator
nodes.rationale: Shallow copy only; nested refs shared.

nodes.label: Optional Chaining (?.)
nodes.rationale: Short-circuits only on null/undefined, not other falsy values.

nodes.label: Nullish Coalescing (??)
nodes.rationale: Falls back only on null/undefined; preserves 0, '', false.

nodes.label: || vs ?? for Defaults
nodes.rationale: || treats 0/''/false as missing; ?? does not.

nodes.label: Map
nodes.rationale: Any-value keys without string coercion; O(1) size; insertion-order iteration.

nodes.label: Set
nodes.rationale: Unique values; SameValueZero equality (reference for objects).

nodes.label: TypedArray / ArrayBuffer
nodes.rationale: Fixed-size typed binary views for performance-critical binary work.

nodes.label: Plain Object Key Coercion Trap
nodes.rationale: Object keys stringify; use Map for object keys.

nodes.label: Event Delegation
nodes.rationale: One ancestor listener uses bubbling and event.target for N children including future ones.

nodes.label: IntersectionObserver
nodes.rationale: Viewport intersection without scroll-polling jank.

nodes.label: Web Worker
nodes.rationale: Separate thread; no DOM; communicate via postMessage.

nodes.label: AbortController
nodes.rationale: Cancels in-flight fetch to prevent stale race conditions in type-ahead search.

nodes.label: try/catch/finally
nodes.rationale: finally always runs for cleanup; return in finally overrides try/catch returns.

nodes.label: Custom Error Classes
nodes.rationale: Extend Error for domain context and instanceof branching.

nodes.label: Proxy
nodes.rationale: Intercepts get/set/has/deleteProperty; basis of Vue 3-style reactive stores.

nodes.label: Symbol
nodes.rationale: Unique keys; well-known symbols customize language behavior (iterator, toPrimitive).

nodes.label: Jest Test Structure Tree
nodes.rationale: describe/test register synchronously at load; bodies run later in execution phase.

nodes.label: Jest Lifecycle Hooks
nodes.rationale: beforeAll/beforeEach/afterEach/afterAll cascade outer→inner.

nodes.label: test.each / describe.each
nodes.rationale: Data-driven generation of one reportable test per table row.

nodes.label: test.only / skip / todo
nodes.rationale: test.only committed accidentally skips entire suite in CI.

nodes.label: expect.toBe
nodes.rationale: Object.is reference equality for primitives/same instance.

nodes.label: expect.toEqual
nodes.rationale: Deep structural equality; ignores undefined props and object type.

nodes.label: expect.toStrictEqual
nodes.rationale: Deep equality plus undefined props and prototype/type checks.

nodes.label: jest.spyOn()
nodes.rationale: Wraps existing method; still calls real impl unless mockImplementation.

nodes.label: jest.mock()
nodes.rationale: Auto-mock, factory, or manual __mocks__ directory.

nodes.label: Jest Fake Timers
nodes.rationale: useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTime for deterministic debounce/throttle tests.

nodes.label: Async Test with await/return
nodes.rationale: Must await or return promise or Jest marks pass before assertions run.

nodes.label: Snapshot Reflexive Update Risk
nodes.rationale: Large snapshots invite unreviewed -u updates that bake in regressions.

nodes.label: RTL Guiding Principle
nodes.rationale: The more tests resemble how software is used, the more confidence they give.

nodes.label: Test Behavior Not Implementation
nodes.rationale: Avoid state/instance access; query by role/label/text like a user.

nodes.label: getBy* Query Variant
nodes.rationale: Throws immediately if 0 or 2+ matches; for elements expected to exist now.

nodes.label: queryBy* Query Variant
nodes.rationale: Returns null if not found; for asserting absence without throwing.

nodes.label: findBy* Query Variant
nodes.rationale: Returns a Promise that polls until found or timeout; for async-appearing elements.

nodes.label: RTL Accessibility-First Query Priority
nodes.rationale: Prefer getByRole, then label/placeholder, then text, then getByTestId as last resort so tests verify a11y as a side effect.

nodes.label: getByRole
nodes.rationale: Preferred default: matches ARIA role + accessible name as assistive tech does.

nodes.label: getByTestId Escape Hatch
nodes.rationale: Last-resort query with no accessibility signal; only when no accessible query works.

nodes.label: fireEvent
nodes.rationale: Dispatches a single isolated DOM event; lower realism, useful for low-level single-event cases like scroll.

nodes.label: user-event (@testing-library/user-event)
nodes.rationale: Simulates full realistic browser event sequences; modern API uses userEvent.setup() and async methods.

nodes.label: userEvent.setup()
nodes.rationale: Returns a bound instance configured once per test; every interaction method is async and must be awaited.

nodes.label: waitFor()
nodes.rationale: Polls a callback until it passes without throwing or timeout elapses.

nodes.label: act() Auto-Wrapping in RTL
nodes.rationale: RTL render/fireEvent/user-event already wrap in act(); warnings signal un-wrapped updates outside RTL.

nodes.label: findBy as getBy+waitFor Shorthand
nodes.rationale: findBy* equals getBy* plus waitFor for the common wait-until-element-appears case.

nodes.label: Custom Render (renderWithProviders)
nodes.rationale: Wraps UI in app providers (Redux, Router, QueryClient, theme) with configurable preloadedState/initialRoute.

nodes.label: RTL Re-Export From test-utils
nodes.rationale: Re-export screen/waitFor/userEvent from one module so tests never import plain unwrapped render by habit.

nodes.label: Fresh Store Per Render Isolation
nodes.rationale: Construct store/QueryClient inside the render function per call to prevent state leakage across tests.

nodes.label: MSW (Mock Service Worker)
nodes.rationale: Intercepts at network layer so real fetch/axios code runs; handlers overridable per test via server.use().

nodes.label: Direct fetch/axios Mocking
nodes.rationale: Replaces client library so real request construction never runs; simpler but less realistic.

nodes.label: MSW server.use() Handler Override
nodes.rationale: Per-test handler override; must reset with server.resetHandlers() after each test.

nodes.label: onUnhandledRequest: error
nodes.rationale: Fail loudly on unmatched requests so broken API calls surface immediately.

nodes.label: renderHook()
nodes.rationale: Mounts a hook in a hidden host component; exposes result.current, rerender, unmount.

nodes.label: result.current
nodes.rationale: Current hook return value; re-read after act()-wrapped updates.

nodes.label: renderHook rerender()
nodes.rationale: Re-invokes hook with new args/props to test reactivity to changing inputs.

nodes.label: renderHook unmount()
nodes.rationale: Triggers hook cleanup (useEffect return) for subscription/leak testing.

nodes.label: jest-axe
nodes.rationale: Automated WCAG rule scan via axe.run(container) and toHaveNoViolations(); catches ~30-50% of real issues.

nodes.label: toHaveAccessibleName / toHaveAccessibleDescription
nodes.rationale: jest-dom matchers for computed accessible name/description as a screen reader would announce.

nodes.label: Implicit A11y via Role Queries
nodes.rationale: Consistent getByRole means missing accessible names fail queries automatically without dedicated tools.

nodes.label: screen.debug()
nodes.rationale: Pretty-prints current rendered DOM; first diagnostic when a query fails.

nodes.label: logRoles()
nodes.rationale: Prints every accessible role and name in a container for correct getByRole construction.

nodes.label: Testing Playground
nodes.rationale: Browser extension/site that suggests queries ranked by RTL priority from pasted HTML.

nodes.label: Browser / BrowserContext / Page Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Browser is expensive process; BrowserContext is isolated session (cookies/storage); Page is a tab sharing context state.

nodes.label: BrowserContext Isolation
nodes.rationale: Fresh context per test is default; shared context causes cookie/localStorage leakage and flaky suites.

nodes.label: Out-of-Process Drivers
nodes.rationale: Native protocol over WebSocket from separate process enables reliable auto-waiting without injecting into page JS.

nodes.label: Multi-Browser Engine Support
nodes.rationale: Same API drives Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit via projects matrix configuration.

nodes.label: Built-In Fixtures (page, context, browser, request)
nodes.rationale: Fixture DI: tests declare needed fixtures as parameters; runner provides fresh instances and teardown.

nodes.label: test.extend() Custom Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Define shared setup once (e.g. authenticatedPage); cleanup after use() call.

nodes.label: Projects Matrix
nodes.rationale: Same suite runs per project entry (browsers/devices/viewports) as configuration, not duplicated code.

nodes.label: Playwright Locator
nodes.rationale: Lazy re-evaluating description, not a snapshot; re-resolves on every action/assertion.

nodes.label: Playwright getByRole Locator
nodes.rationale: Preferred primary locator matching accessibility tree role + name; mirrors RTL philosophy.

nodes.label: Locator Strictness Mode
nodes.rationale: Action/assertion on multi-match locator throws rather than silently using first match.

nodes.label: Locator filter() Chaining
nodes.rationale: Narrow broad locators by hasText/nested locators before acting on a specific item.

nodes.label: locator.fill()
nodes.rationale: Clears field and sets value directly without per-keystroke events; default for most forms.

nodes.label: locator.pressSequentially()
nodes.rationale: Dispatches real keydown/keyup per character for keystroke-driven UI (counters, masks, autocomplete).

nodes.label: setInputFiles()
nodes.rationale: Sets file input value directly, bypassing native OS file picker automation cannot control.

nodes.label: locator.dragTo()
nodes.rationale: Purpose-built drag-and-drop sequence between source and target locators.

nodes.label: Web-First Assertions
nodes.rationale: expect(locator) polls/retries until pass or timeout instead of one-shot check.

nodes.label: Actionability Checks
nodes.rationale: Before actions: wait until visible, stable, enabled, and not covered.

nodes.label: expect.soft()
nodes.rationale: Records failure but continues so multiple independent checks report together.

nodes.label: page.route()
nodes.rationale: Intercepts at browser network layer before network; fulfill/modify/continue any request type.

nodes.label: HAR Replay (routeFromHAR)
nodes.rationale: Replay recorded traffic for deterministic E2E without live backend; can drift from real API.

nodes.label: page.waitForResponse()
nodes.rationale: Waits for and returns a matching response for asserting real network activity.

nodes.label: Avoid networkidle as General Wait
nodes.rationale: Polling/analytics/WebSockets may never idle; prefer web-first UI asserts or waitForResponse.

nodes.label: storageState Session Reuse
nodes.rationale: Login once, serialize cookies/localStorage; subsequent tests load file and skip UI login.

nodes.label: Global Setup Auth Project
nodes.rationale: Dedicated setup project runs once; main projects depend on it and set storageState path.

nodes.label: Per-Role Auth Files
nodes.rationale: Separate storageState files (admin/member) for role-specific projects without inline login.

nodes.label: Test-Scoped Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Default: fresh instance per test for maximum isolation.

nodes.label: Worker-Scoped Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Created once per worker for expensive read-only setup; unsafe if tests mutate shared state.

nodes.label: Automatic Fixtures (auto: true)
nodes.rationale: Run for every test without being destructured; for universal logging/instrumentation only.

nodes.label: toHaveScreenshot()
nodes.rationale: Pixel-diff against baseline; first run captures baseline, later runs compare with thresholds.

nodes.label: maxDiffPixelRatio / threshold Tuning
nodes.rationale: Absorb font/anti-aliasing noise while still catching real layout regressions.

nodes.label: Screenshot Mask for Dynamic Content
nodes.rationale: Exclude timestamps/rotating content from pixel comparison to avoid false failures.

nodes.label: --update-snapshots Workflow
nodes.rationale: Regenerate baselines only after deliberate visual review, not as reflexive fix.

nodes.label: Trace Viewer
nodes.rationale: Post-mortem: DOM snapshots, network, console per action; show-trace opens interactive UI.

nodes.label: Playwright Inspector (PWDEBUG)
nodes.rationale: Live step-through debugger with selector picker; local only, never in CI scripts.

nodes.label: playwright codegen
nodes.rationale: Records interactions into draft test code; refine locators and add assertions before commit.

nodes.label: Playwright UI Mode
nodes.rationale: Interactive watch-mode runner with time-travel debugging of actions.

nodes.label: Playwright Workers
nodes.rationale: N worker processes each with own browser; parallelize across files (and within if fullyParallel).

nodes.label: CI Sharding (--shard)
nodes.rationale: Split suite across separate CI machines for wall-clock speedup beyond single-machine workers.

nodes.label: test.describe.serial()
nodes.rationale: Ordered dependent steps; later tests skip if earlier fails; use sparingly.

nodes.label: test.describe.parallel()
nodes.rationale: Opt-in concurrent tests within a file; only for fully independent tests.

nodes.label: Playwright CT mount()
nodes.rationale: Mounts one component in real browser engine; middle ground between jsdom RTL and full E2E.

nodes.label: CT vs RTL vs Full E2E Tradeoff
nodes.rationale: Use CT for real layout/scroll/CSS-dependent logic; keep most unit tests on faster RTL jsdom.
nodes.norm_label: ct vs rtl vs full e2e tradeoff

nodes.label: CT Experimental Status
nodes.rationale: API still evolving; track stability across Playwright upgrades.

nodes.label: request Fixture (APIRequestContext)
nodes.rationale: Real HTTP without browser; seed/verify data faster than UI setup.

nodes.label: API Setup + UI Verification Pattern
nodes.rationale: Create state via API, assert via page for focused, faster, lower blast-radius tests.

nodes.label: request Auth Independent of page
nodes.rationale: request does not automatically share page storageState; pass headers or project config explicitly.

nodes.label: Multi-Reporter CI Output
nodes.rationale: list + html + junit simultaneously for console, local report, and CI dashboards.

nodes.label: CI Retries (retries: 2)
nodes.rationale: Retry only in CI for env variance; keep 0 locally so flakiness is immediate signal.

nodes.label: Official Playwright Docker Image
nodes.rationale: Pre-installed browsers + OS deps; pin version to match @playwright/test package.

nodes.label: trace: on-first-retry
nodes.rationale: Capture traces only when needed; upload artifacts on failure for Trace Viewer.

nodes.label: Page Object Model (POM)
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates locators and actions per page so locator churn updates one class, not every test file.

nodes.label: Custom Matchers via expect.extend
nodes.rationale: Domain-specific assertions using the same mechanism as Jest expect.extend.

nodes.label: Test Tagging (@smoke / @regression)
nodes.rationale: Tag curated subsets for different CI stages; filter with --grep / --grep-invert.

nodes.label: Keep Assertions Out of Page Objects
nodes.rationale: Embedding test-specific assertions in POM couples it to outcomes and reduces reusability; tests assert, POM acts.
nodes.norm_label: keep assertions out of page objects

nodes.label: One Page Object Per Logical Page
nodes.rationale: Giant multi-page flow objects recreate the maintainability problem POM was meant to solve.
nodes.norm_label: one page object per logical page

nodes.label: Component Isolation in Storybook
nodes.rationale: Render one component state without routing, backend, or global data layer.

nodes.label: Component Story Format 3 (CSF3)
nodes.rationale: Object-based stories with args; framework renders the component rather than hand-written JSX returns.

nodes.label: Custom render Function

nodes.label: Meta/Story args Merge Semantics
nodes.rationale: Story-level args merge with meta-level defaults; they do not fully replace them.

nodes.label: Controls Addon
nodes.rationale: Live prop-editing UI generated from argTypes.

nodes.label: Docgen Auto-Generated Controls

nodes.rationale: Pixel-diff every story against approved baselines in PR review UI.

nodes.rationale: axe-core catches roughly 30-50% of WCAG issues; pair with keyboard and screen-reader testing.

nodes.rationale: Function wrapping story output to provide theme/router/store context.

nodes.rationale: Document colors/spacing/typography from the actual token source of truth.

nodes.label: Server State vs Client State
nodes.rationale: Remote-owned, potentially stale, shared, async — not the same as useState/Redux ownership.

nodes.label: Automatic Request Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Multiple useQuery calls with the same key share one cache entry and one in-flight request.

nodes.label: Create QueryClient Once
nodes.rationale: Instantiating QueryClient inside a component body recreates an empty cache every render.

nodes.label: staleTime Freshness Window
nodes.rationale: How long data is fresh; while fresh, no auto-refetch on mount/focus/reconnect.

nodes.label: gcTime Cache Retention
nodes.rationale: How long unused cache entries persist after last observer unmounts (formerly cacheTime).

nodes.label: staleTime vs gcTime Distinction
nodes.rationale: staleTime controls refetch frequency; gcTime controls post-unmount retention — conflating them is the top confusion.

nodes.label: status (pending|error|success)
nodes.rationale: Data availability axis independent of network activity.

nodes.label: isLoading = isPending && isFetching

nodes.label: refetchQueries

nodes.label: Prefer invalidateQueries Over refetchQueries
